rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KRIcarlo
rows.Origin:
Bred by Michel Kriloff (France, before 1982).
Introduced in United States by Armstrong Roses in 1984 as 'Maréchale LeClerc'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-pink. Mild fragrance. 25 to 50 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Heat tolerant. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to Mildew. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
